record.question: Consider the statement - Without the written permission of the Court, no one will be allowed to have access to under trial prisoner in the precincts of a Court awaiting trial. (i) Facilities will however be given to a legal practitioner who has obtained the aforesaid permission to see a prisoner for whose defence he is engaged for the purpose of consultation. (ii) To get the Vakalatnama signed by the prisoners. (iii) On no account should a prisoner be left unguarded. (iv) Touts should never be allowed to approach an accused under trial.
